1.title: New White House Counsel Isn’t a Yes Man, but He Won’t Say No, Either
1.summary: Will Scharf has proved his loyalty to President Trump, even filming a TV ad in which he blows away documents from the president’s legal cases. His new role will be to provide in-house legal advice.

2.title: Judge Allows Option of Manslaughter Verdict in Lindsay Clancy Case
2.summary: If jurors find Ms. Clancy guilty in the strangling deaths of her three children, they will choose among first-degree murder, second-degree murder and manslaughter.

3.title: He Thought He Destroyed a Flock Camera, but It Was a Decoy, Police Say
3.summary: A Florida man is facing three felony charges over the Aug. 20 vandalism of a plastic reproduction of one of the automated license plate readers, the authorities said.

4.title: Live Updates: Hundreds Missing as Wall of Water Sweeps Away Villages in Nepal and Tibet
4.summary: At least 160 people were killed when floods tore through a Himalayan river valley between Nepal and the Tibet region of China, the authorities said. Hundreds were missing, including foreign tourists.

5.title: US drug agency approves breakthrough treatment for pancreatic cancer
5.summary: Experts have hailed the drug, daraxonrasib, as a game changer for one of the world's deadliest cancers.

6.title: Canadians Stand Their Ground Amid New Trump Tariffs and Expanding U.S.-Canada Trade War
6.summary: Business owners are preparing for financial pain after the latest U.S.-Canada trade talks collapsed. But many Canadians are embracing a show of resistance.
